summary: Targeted retest of the ONE high-priority overlap bug reported in iteration_13.json: client session-screen exercise-ai-guide button being covered by the fixed 'Complete & Check In' CTA bar. Fix applied in /app/frontend/app/session/[id].tsx (ScrollView contentContainerStyle paddingBottom changed from fixed 150 to dynamic '132 + insets.bottom'). VERIFIED FIXED for both client and coach views.
critical_code_review_comments: The dynamic paddingBottom (132 + insets.bottom) correctly guarantees the scrollable content area is taller than the sticky footer, allowing the last exercise block (and its AI guide button) to be scrolled fully clear of the fixed CTA bar's hit area. Confirmed via elementFromPoint hit-testing at the AI button's exact bounding-box center after scrolling the internal ScrollView to its max scrollTop — it now correctly resolves to 'exercise-ai-guide-1' instead of 'complete-log-btn'/'edit-session-btn'.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not tested this iteration, out of scope)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (1/1 targeted bug retested and confirmed fixed for both client and coach roles)

seed_data_creation: None - reused existing seeded data (jcgfit coach's Rowing Strength Program — 4-Week Cycle, Week 1 Day 2 'UT2 Recovery Row', the exact 1-exercise session from iteration_13's bug report; ilovejeremygillespie client's assignment of the same session)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduced the exact iteration_13 scenario: client 'ilovejeremygillespie@gmail.com' logs in, Today's Workout shows 'Week 1 Day 2 — UT2 Recovery Row' with only 1 exercise. Before scrolling, the AI button and CTA bar visually occupy the same screen region (expected, since the ScrollView content isn't scrolled yet) - elementFromPoint at that unscrolled position resolves to complete-log-btn, which is correct/expected browser behavior since the button isn't in view/interactable state yet. After scrolling the internal ScrollView (found via querying overflowY:auto/scroll divs, not document/mouse-wheel since RN-web ScrollView is a nested div) to its max scrollTop (266 of 933 scrollHeight, clientHeight 667), the AI button moved to y=347 (fully clear of the CTA bar at y=599-651), and elementFromPoint correctly resolved to 'exercise-ai-guide-1'. Tapping it opened the ExerciseGuideSheet ('Getting AI guidance...' loading state visible), NOT the Daily Check-in modal. Same verification repeated for coach's session-preview view (same URL/session, edit-session-btn instead of complete-log-btn) - also correctly resolves to exercise-ai-guide-1 with no overlap. Bug from iteration_13 is now RESOLVED. No other regressions found; this was a narrow scoped retest per main agent's request and no other areas were tested.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this is confirmation of fix, not a new bug. Original RCA remains valid (see iteration_13.json); fix (dynamic paddingBottom = 132 + insets.bottom vs previous fixed 150) resolves it by ensuring enough scrollable slack exists below the last exercise card so it can always be scrolled clear of the fixed-position footer bar.
